root_cause.text: The `wx_sw_init` function unconditionally reads the Physical Function (PF) restricted register `WX_CFG_PORT_ST` to determine the bus function ID, even when initializing a Virtual Function (VF) device.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in `wx_sw_init()`, the assignment `wx->bus.func = FIELD_GET(WX_CFG_PORT_ST_LANID, rd32(wx, WX_CFG_PORT_ST));` is modified to check `if (pdev->is_virtfn)` and use `PCI_FUNC(pdev->devfn)` instead of reading the `WX_CFG_PORT_ST` register when the device is a virtual function.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix virtual function number assignment by querying the PCI configuration space instead of physical port registers.
intent_record.what: Introduced a conditional check on pdev->is_virtfn to assign wx->bus.func using PCI_FUNC(pdev->devfn) for virtual functions, while retaining the register-read fallback for physical functions.
intent_record.how: Ensures virtual functions correctly identify their function number via standard PCI configuration space rather than attempting to read physical port status registers which may be inaccurate or inaccessible.
